title: Media Executive
description:
**Job Title: Junior Executive – Media Ops and Servicing** 




**Location: Worli, Mumbai (On\-site)** 




  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for a detail\-oriented Junior Executive – Media Ops and Servicing to support the execution and management of digital advertising campaigns. This role involves campaign setup, monitoring performance, and ensuring smooth coordination between clients and internal teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Set up and manage digital ad campaigns across platforms (Google, Meta, Display, etc.).
* Monitor campaign performance, pacing, and budget utilization.
* Handle ad trafficking, including creative uploads and tracking implementation.
* Ensure accurate targeting, placement, and delivery of campaigns.
* Generate campaign performance reports and highlight key insights.
* Identify and escalate technical issues related to ads and tracking.
* Support client servicing by sharing updates and managing expectations.
* Assist in pitch preparation, including proposals and presentations.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth campaign execution.
* Stay updated on digital advertising trends and best practices.



  





**Preferred Skills:** 



* 1–2\.5 years of experience in digital media, ad operations, or campaign management.
* Understanding of digital advertising platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Display Networks.
* Knowledge of campaign setup, ad trafficking, tracking implementation, and reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across teams and stakeholders.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Awareness of digital advertising trends, media amplification, and campaign optimization techniques.
* Prior experience in Ad Ops or media servicing will be an added advantage.

title: Manager/Sr. Manager YouTube (Leadership Role)
description:
**WE ARE HIRING \| HEAD – YOUTUBE OPERATIONS** 




**Rajshri Entertainment Private Limited \| Mumbai** 




 Rajshri Entertainment Private Limited is looking for an experienced
 **Head – YouTube Operations** 
 to lead the growth, audience development and operations of its YouTube network.
 



 The role will be responsible for driving YouTube performance across the network, with a strong focus on
 **views, watch time, subscriber growth, content programming, analytics and overall channel health** 
 .
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
 • Lead YouTube operations and audience growth across Rajshri’s network of channels.
 



 • Develop and execute strategies to increase views, watch time, subscribers and engagement.
 



 • Manage the operations and growth of Rajshri’s flagship YouTube channel.
 



 • Lead and mentor a team of YouTube Channel Managers.
 



 • Oversee YouTube CMS, Content ID, claims and channel\-related operations.
 



 • Analyse YouTube Analytics and translate insights into actionable growth strategies.
 



 • Plan and execute YouTube advertising and promotional campaigns.
 



 • Manage interactions with YouTube partners and platform representatives.
 



 • Collaborate closely with Content, Content Acquisition, Social Media and Creative teams.
 



 • Drive content programming, metadata optimisation and consistent publishing schedules.
 



 • Conduct regular competitor and market analysis to identify trends and growth opportunities.
 



 • Maintain accurate records of published content, metadata, creatives and performance.
 



 • Ensure the overall health, compliance and performance of YouTube channels.
 



 • Prepare regular performance reports and provide insights to senior management.
 


 Candidate Profile
 
 • 8\+ years of relevant experience in
 **YouTube Operations, Digital Media, Content Distribution or Entertainment** 
 .
 



 • Proven experience in managing and growing YouTube channels at scale.
 



 • Strong understanding of YouTube Analytics, CMS, Content ID, copyright and monetisation.
 



 • Experience in leading teams and managing cross\-functional stakeholders.
 



 • Strong analytical, strategic and communication skills.
 



 • Experience in Media, Entertainment, OTT, Broadcasting or Digital Content will be preferred.
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



 Interested candidates can share their updated resume at careers@rajshri.com / jobs@rajshri.com
 



**Rajshri Entertainment Private Limited** 




 Part of the Rajshri Group \| Established in 1947
